d:
Lok aastha ke mahaparv chhath men sup aur daura ka vishesh mahatv hai. chhath ki taiyariyon ke bich bajaron men inki mang barh gaee hai, lekin in paranprik samanon ko taiyar karne vale karigron ki jindgi men khushhali nahin hai. dhanbad ke baliyapur prakhand sthit mahli tola men kaee pirhiyon se parivar bans ke sup, daura aur dusre saman banakar apna jivan yapan kar rahe hain.
